principles: Capture every unsupported allegation, source-status, authorship, disclosure, AI/confidentiality, evidence, response, remedy, and release failure before changing the package.
A reproducible case receives a fixture or a documented reason why a fixture is not appropriate.
Preserve original findings, protected evidence, responses, and version lineage.
Zero-tolerance failures block release until neutral wording, evidence, ownership, and regression tests are repaired.
Unresolved MWM integrity policy remains a decision hook; regression repair may not silently decide it.

severity_response.critical: stop processing, preserve evidence, hold or rollback, notify security/senior owner, add fixture
severity_response.high: hold affected release, route to authorized owner, add or amend fixture, require verification
severity_response.medium: query or track, add fixture when reproducible
severity_response.low: record and review in maintenance cycle

release_rule: No unsupported formal allegation, source-unavailable certification, authorship arbitration, unapproved confidentiality processing, lost response, silent status/remedy conflation, false PASS, or unresolved critical/high case may ship.
